caption: The drawing depicts a square textile with a blue background and a pattern rendered in an off-white or light beige color. The central motif consists of a flowering plant with multiple branches, large blossoms, smaller flowers, and leaves that extend across the majority of the textile. At the top edge of the square, there is a horizontal decorative border made up of regularly spaced oval shapes, each outlined and filled with the same light color. Along the bottom edge, there is another horizontal border consisting of repeated stylized star or flower shapes. The texture suggests a woven fabric, and the design elements are clearly defined against the solid blue background, occupying the central area while the surrounding mat remains plain and unembellished. The image is centered on a blank background with a faint signature or inscription at the bottom right corner of the mat.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
